node.title: Re: Strange and special comments in OpenXPKI Code in the form ##! 2: "new: class instantiated" in OpenXPKI Code
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: It appears to be some custom debugging code implemented in [https://github.com/openxpki/openxpki/blob/224a569984fd/core/server/OpenXPKI/Debug.pm|OpenXPKI::Debug]. The POD at the bottom of the file describes it a bit.
